'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Best Deck Ever, Period. Line 8 Outrider (Squadron Assignments already at line 3). Line 27 struck (extra OOC&TT / Laser Cannon). Line 59 [[Control & Transmission Terminated]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
